name: Text as a whole
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2017/1938 as regards the role of gas storage for securing gas supplies ahead of the winter season
part_text:
The European Parliament wants to keep rules that force countries to fill their gas storage before winter, but make them easier to meet. The target drops from 90% to 83% full by 1 December, and countries can fill less when market conditions are bad. The rules would run until the end of 2027 instead of expiring in 2025. Countries must also report how much Russian gas they store.

- Target lowered to 83% full, with up to four points of flexibility in bad market conditions.
- Affects EU countries, storage operators and gas traders; rules extended to end of 2027.
- Next: negotiations with EU governments, who must agree before it becomes law.
